topics.content:
PHYSICAL AND HEALTH EDUCATION (PHE)
SECOND TERM
WEEK 2
PRIMARY 3
THEME - SPORTS AND GAMES
PREVIOUS LESSON - As stated in Second Term (Term 2) Week 1 Plan Lesson Notes for Primary Schools
TOPIC - BALL GAMES - FOOTBALL
LEARNING AREA
1. Introduction
2. Meaning of Football Games
3. Basic Skills in Football Games
4. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. describe the football game.
2. list the skills in football.
3. demonstrate and perform the skills in football.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The people can describe the football game.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. Footballs
2. Whistle
3. Football pitch
4. White maker board or chalkboard.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON ONE - INTRODUCTION
Football is a game played by two teams, eleven players each using a ball.
Football game is played by kicking the ball to each other of the same team and try scoring goals into a wide net by kicking the ball.
Football is the most played game in the world, and there is lot of followers in the world for the game.
BASIC SKILLS IN FOOTBALL GAME
The following are the basic skills in football game,
1. Dribbling
2. Shooting
3. Defending
4. Passing
5. Ball control
6. Goalkeeping
For more details, for the link - Meaning of Ball Games | Examples of Ball Games | Basic Skill in Table Tennis Primary 3 (Basic 3)
LESSON 2 - FOOTBALL KITS AND EQUIPMENTS
The following kits and equipments are used for playing football game,
1. Football pitch with goal posts
2. Ball
3. Jersey
4. Whistle
5. Boots
PERFORMING BASIC IN FOOTBALL
Demonstrate and guide the pupils to practice and demonstrate basic in football game.
REVISION AND WEEK LESSON ASSESSMENT
As stated in performance objectives or lesson evaluation.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays chart showing football match or play a short football match. You can as well make use of the sport paper, if available.
3. Asks pupils identify and describe the game on the chart.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify and describe the game on the chart.
4. Uses pupil’s responses to introduce the lesson and explain.
Pupil’s Activities - Pay attention to the lesson introduction.
6. Displays chart showing different skills in football game.
7. Guides pupils to identify each of the skills in football game and discuss.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify each of the skills in football game and discuss.
8. Demonstrates the skills.
Pupil’s Activities - Watch the teacher as he/she demonstrates the skills and practice.
9. Organizes short football match for the boys and girls.
Pupil’s Activities - Take part in the football match.
10. Supervises as the pupil’s practice and match.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
LESSON EVALUATION
Asks pupils to:
1. explain football games.
2. list 5 skills in football;
3. perform the skills in football.
WEEKLY ASSESSMENT (TEST)
ATTEMPT ALL THE QUESTIONS
1. ________ is a game played by two teams, eleven players each using a ball.
A. Football
B. Basketball
C. Tennis ball
2. ________ is played by kicking the ball to each other of the same team and try scoring goals into a wide net by kicking the ball.
A. Tennis ball
B. Basketball
C. Football
3. Football game in which two teams of ________.
A. Eleven players
B. 11 players
C. A and B
4. Shooting and defending are basic skills in ________.
A. ball games
B. football
C. basketball
5. The role of goalkeeper is ________.
A. shoot ball
B. defend ball
C. keep ball
6. Match the following with the corresponding:
Goalkeeping           defender
Defending               goalkeeper
7. ________ and ________ are your favourite basic skills in football ball.
8. ________ is a trainer of a football team.
A. Coach
B. Captain
C. Defender
9. Goalkeeper and defender are player in football game.
A. True
B. False
B. No
10. ________ is the team leader of a football team.
A. Coach
B. Captain
C. Defender
